description.value: Pomme Natural Market is a 100% BC-owned natural grocery store offering certified organic and local spray-free produce, ethically sourced groceries, and a large wellness department stocked with natural supplements and skincare. The Nanaimo location has been voted Best of the City by the Nanaimo News Bulletin for five consecutive years and partners with growers and producers across Vancouver Island and the Gulf Islands. It is a solid resupply stop for touring cyclists seeking high-quality, whole-food provisions.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 11m; rack at 61m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's /contact-nanaimo page confirms the OSM address (6560 Metral Drive, Nanaimo, BC V9T 2L9) and phone (250 390-1955) exactly. The homepage and about-us pages confirm this is a full natural grocery store with certified organic produce, ethical groceries, and supplements; the homepage also references a deli 'that caters to all dietary preferences,' though no explicit deli mention appears on the Nanaimo-specific page. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, award-winning natural grocery store in Nanaimo confirmed open and active — a useful resupply point for touring cyclists seeking organic and whole-food options on Vancouver Island.

wow_evidence: voted Best of the City by the Nanaimo News Bulletin for five consecutive years
